quests.desc: Welcome to another fast paced round of TextWorld! First thing I need you to do is to attempt to take a trip north. Okay, and then, retrieve the type E key from the counter. After taking the type E key, move south. After that, assure that the type E gateway inside the sauna is unlocked. After that, open the type E gateway. And then, make an attempt to go east. And then, venture east. After that, open the pine passageway in the closet. Then, venture north. After that, move west. With that over with, pick up the cake scented keycard from the floor of the shower. And then, look and see that the cake scented door within the shower is unlocked. And then, open the cake scented door. After that, make an attempt to venture north. Then, head east. Next, ensure that the gateway inside the studio is open. After that, attempt to move north. With that over with, retrieve the passkey from the floor of the cubicle. And if you do that, you're the winner!

objective: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to move north. With that done, pick up the type E key from the counter. After that, make an effort to go to the south. With that accomplished, unlock the type E gateway inside the sauna. After unlocking the type E gateway, open the type E gateway. Then, attempt to venture east. Following that, travel east. After that, ensure that the pine passageway in the closet is open. Then, make an attempt to take a trip north. And then, go to the west. If you can manage that, recover the cake scented keycard from the floor of the shower. Once you have taken the cake scented keycard, insert the cake scented keycard into the cake scented door's lock to unlock it. After that, doublecheck that the cake scented door in the shower is opened. And then, go to the north. Once you get through with that, make an attempt to take a trip east. Then, ensure that the gateway is open. After that, attempt to go north. With that accomplished, pick-up the passkey from the floor of the cubicle. That's it!
